meta.description: Machine-readable FSSAI Phase-1 claim rules for the URE Nutrition Claim Verifier.
meta.decision_basis: Fixed thresholds per 100 g (solids) or per 100 ml (liquids). Deterministic and easy to defend.

rda_reference.note: ICMR-NIN adult reference. Used ONLY for informational %RDA text, not for pass/fail in Phase-1.

meta.form_note: If the panel is declared per serving (not per 100 g/ml), the engine adds a warning and asks the user to verify.

claims.pass_text: Protein meets the High Protein threshold (>= 20% of RDA).
claims.fail_text: Protein is below the High Protein threshold (>= 20% of RDA).

claims.pass_text: Protein meets the Source of Protein threshold (>= 10% of RDA).
claims.fail_text: Protein is below the Source of Protein threshold (>= 10% of RDA).

claims.pass_text: Total sugars are within the Sugar Free limit (<= 0.5 g).
claims.fail_text: Total sugars exceed the Sugar Free limit (<= 0.5 g).

claims.pass_text: Total sugars are within the Low Sugar limit.
claims.fail_text: Total sugars exceed the Low Sugar limit.

claims.unit: g added sugars per 100 g / 100 ml
claims.pass_text: No added sugar ingredients detected and added-sugar value is within limit.
claims.fail_text: An added-sugar ingredient was detected although the claim says 'No Added Sugar'.
claims.deceptive_note: Numeric value may pass, but a sugar substitute / hidden sugar ingredient is present.

claims.pass_text: Dietary fibre meets the High Fibre threshold.
claims.fail_text: Dietary fibre is below the High Fibre threshold.

claims.pass_text: Dietary fibre meets the Source of Fibre threshold.
claims.fail_text: Dietary fibre is below the Source of Fibre threshold.

claims.pass_text: Total fat is within the Low Fat limit.
claims.fail_text: Total fat exceeds the Low Fat limit.

claims.pass_text: A 100% wholewheat claim is consistent with the ingredients list.
claims.fail_text: A 100% wholewheat claim is contradicted by refined flour (maida) in the ingredients.

prohibited_terms.message: Claim uses a term that is prohibited or high-risk under FSSAI advertising & claims regulations unless specifically approved.

mandatory_checks.note: Phase-1 records these as informational warnings only; they are not hard blocks.
